text: General terms: customers may return most items within 30 days of delivery with proof of purchase. Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

Garden equipment (lawn mowers, hedge trimmers, leaf blowers): returns are accepted within 14 days only. A restocking fee of 15% applies to all opened items. Fuel-powered items must be drained before return.

Cordless power tools (drills, impact drivers, circular saws): returns are accepted within 90 days if the tool is registered online. No restocking fee applies. Batteries are covered by a separate 2-year warranty.
Clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders placed before 2 pm ship the same day.
Large garden equipment such as ride-on mowers ships by freight and takes 5 to 8 business days. Freight deliveries need a signature.
All power tools carry a 2-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover blades or wear parts.
To make a warranty claim, contact support with the order number and a photo of the fault. Claims are answered within 2 business days.
Replacement blade HT-450-B fits the HT-450 hedge trimmer. Replacement blade HT-600-B fits the HT-600 and HT-650 models.
The 18V battery pack BP-18-4Ah fits all 18V cordless tools. The charger CH-18 charges a 4Ah battery in 60 minutes.
Customers can see refund status under Orders in their account. A refund shows as Processing until the bank confirms it.
UK stores: customers can return items within 30 days under the Consumer Contracts Regulations. Faulty items can be returned within 6 months.
